spec_match.rationale: The four experiments are the spec's three exact contracts (canonicalisation default, changed-boolean return, removeUnsafe override) plus full get() inspection, each annotated with the specified expectation.

interactive.rationale: Each experiment has its own run button performing the real constructor/method calls and printing real return values or real exceptions; a checkbox toggles truncated vs full JSON.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises the lifecycle probed step by step with real return values; that is what each experiment prints.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the no-op repeat call, the explicit-true-then-removeUnsafe override, and distinguishes an absent key in get() (ignored unknown member) from partial support.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5169798320357376 and the HTML Standard setJavascriptURLs anchor.

conformance.rationale: Experiments 1-3 mirror conformance assertions safe-config-canonicalises-to-false, setter-returns-changed-boolean and remove-unsafe-forces-false one to one.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (Playwright CDP): all four experiment buttons clicked at 1280×800 and 360×740; each output showed the real 'ReferenceError: Sanitizer is not defined' with feature-detection advice; zero console errors / failed requests, 0px horizontal overflow both classes, screenshots captured. DOWNGRADED pass→partial (review finding, 2026-10-18): Chromium 141 lacks the Sanitizer API, so only the fallback/exception branch executed — the supported-path primary interaction (real sanitization output on a Sanitizer-enabled build) remains unverified, and fallback-only verification is partial by this rubric’s own standard. Re-run on Chrome 146+/157 to upgrade.

telemetry_health.rationale: Per-experiment asserts (sanitizer-jsurls-exp-*) on success and explicit *-absent asserts tied to the real exception type on the fallback branch.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons pair background and color; ok/bad text uses accent-emerald-dark and accent-rose on light surfaces for AA.

accessibility.rationale: Each output is aria-live=polite and tied to its button; code samples are tabindex=0 scrollable; focus-visible outline on controls.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both classes exercised headlessly: no horizontal overflow (0px), single-column experiment cards, 44px buttons.

openQuestions.title: Capture the passing experiment outputs on a 157 build
openQuestions.detail: All four experiments currently exercise the honest ReferenceError branch on Chromium 141. On a Chrome 157 binary, verify experiment outputs read true/false exactly as the annotated spec expectations state, and that get() lists javascriptURLs alongside comments and dataAttributes.

guidanceConsulted.query: sanitize untrusted HTML safely setHTML Sanitizer API
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Feature-detect the Sanitizer surface with 'in' checks before use.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Banner and fallback messaging are driven by typeof Sanitizer and 'setJavascriptURLs' in Sanitizer.prototype; the printed advice teaches the same detection.

guidanceConsulted.query: status updates live region aria-live announce result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce outcomes programmatically where the visual state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Experiment outputs are aria-live polite regions updated only on explicit user action.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form control panel layout without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer intrinsic single-column flow on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Experiment cards are a single-column grid; pre blocks scroll internally; 0px overflow measured at 360px.

summary: Probes the three precise contracts PR 12898 gives the option — canonicalisation, changed-boolean returns, removeUnsafe override — with real calls and annotated expectations, printing genuine exceptions on pre-157 browsers. Verified headlessly on Chromium 141 at both viewport classes, clean console, no overflow.
